summary: Members of Council may file petitions.
decided: City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "Urge Change to the Staples Proposal to Preserve our Neighbourhood", submitted by Councillor Mike Layton, Ward 11, University-Rosedale, containing the names of approximately 182 persons. 2. Petition headed "Move the Train Yard from Thorncliffe Park", submitted by Councillor Jaye Robinson, Ward 15, Don Valley West, containing the names of approximately 8,620 persons.
text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "Urge Change to the Staples Proposal to Preserve our Neighbourhood", submitted by Councillor Mike Layton, Ward 11, University-Rosedale, containing the names of approximately 182 persons. 2. Petition headed "Move the Train Yard from Thorncliffe Park", submitted by Councillor Jaye Robinson, Ward 15, Don Valley West, containing the names of approximately 8,620 persons.
